metrics.r2_predictive: 1 - sum((predicted - observed)^2) / sum((observed - mean(observed))^2); may be negative
metrics.pearson_r_squared: squared Pearson correlation; does not penalize constant offsets or scale errors

aggregation: arithmetic mean over finite conformer predictions; equal conformer weights
mask: intersection of experimental assignments and finite means across all six methods and both states
missing_HA: BMRB 17760 has no HA assignments; metrics left empty
source_limitations: Pickles contain residue numbers and atom names but no residue identities; checked original PDB sequences and mapped ordered residue labels
Matching frame counts do not by themselves establish exact frame identity
Original uses all available columns, relaxed uses surviving conformers; no frame pairing assumed
Before/after includes reconstruction and relaxation effects
Experimental p53 1–93 vs modeled p53 1–28; terminal context differs
